earnings_quality_bridge.disagreement: Company-adjusted profit is group-scope, not parent-attributable; it cannot be divided by shares as a like-for-like adjusted EPS without a scope bridge.

capital_allocation.per_share_test: Judge reinvestment only by fully diluted per-share cash economics and bond coverage, not revenue growth alone.

maturity_stress.limitations: June cash, bank debt and operating cash are not disclosed in the monthly return; this is a date-mixed stress test, not a liquidity forecast.

convertible_three_path_scenarios.debt_treatment: Retain remaining principal and redeem at about 101.51% at maturity.
convertible_three_path_scenarios.share_treatment: No CB conversion shares; options remain separate.
convertible_three_path_scenarios.cash_or_dilution: Approximate HK$1,480.016m cash need on the June remaining principal.

convertible_three_path_scenarios.debt_treatment: Converted principal is removed from debt according to bond terms.
convertible_three_path_scenarios.share_treatment: Up to 248,381,602 remaining conversion shares at HK$5.87 as of June.
convertible_three_path_scenarios.cash_or_dilution: Lower redemption cash need but higher share count; conversion is not automatic above strike.

convertible_three_path_scenarios.debt_treatment: Replace, repurchase or amend the outstanding bond before maturity.
convertible_three_path_scenarios.share_treatment: Depends on new instrument, placement, conversion-price or repurchase terms.
convertible_three_path_scenarios.cash_or_dilution: Can trade near-term cash relief for interest cost, collateral, covenant or dilution.

owner_earnings.reason: Maintenance versus growth development cost, normal working capital, acquisition scope and NCI attribution cannot be defensibly separated.
limitations: CFO - PPE - intangible additions was -HK$363.449m in FY2025 and is shown only as a conservative cash proxy.
Capitalized development may include both maintenance and growth; expensing all is conservative but not an owner-earnings estimate.

historical_valuation.look_ahead_control: Historical PE requires EPS known on each historical date; current FY2025 EPS must not be backfilled.
historical_valuation.peer_comparison: No normalized pure-play peer set; platform internal tools are substitutes, not valuation comparables.
historical_valuation.reason: No point-in-time filing-availability EPS series has been built.

market_positioning.interpretation: Price is near its 20-day mean but below 60/200-day means. Reportable short positions declined from selected January/April observations, so persistent weakness cannot be attributed to rising disclosed shorts alone.
limitations: Technical state describes supply/demand, not support/resistance certainty.
SFC positions have thresholds and reporting lag.

price_move_attribution.rule: T-1 close to T0/T+1/T+5, Hang Seng benchmark, excess return, overlapping events and causal confidence.

positive_evidence: FY2025 revenue reached HK$2.872bn; subscription MRR rose from company-reported US$9m in 2023 to US$15m in 2025.
Active monetizing assets rose from 3.70m at 2024Q4 to 5.24m at 2026Q1 on company definitions.
Rights fingerprints, platform integrations, historical claims and customer workflow can create data and switching frictions.
counter_evidence: YouTube is developing internal synthetic-singing and likeness identification within Content ID.
Receivables, capitalized development and goodwill rose faster than cash conversion.
Top-five customers are 40% of revenue and platform policy changes already affected monetization per management.
missing_tests: Cohort NRR and gross retention by product/geography.
Win/loss data against platform-native and third-party tools.
Unit gross margin per active asset and incremental cash conversion.

red_team.mechanism: YouTube/Meta build identification, policy and monetization inside the platform.
red_team.invalidation_test: Platform releases do not reduce asset growth, NRR, pricing or monetization margin for four reporting periods.

red_team.mechanism: Capitalized development, acquisitions and receivable growth defer economic cost and absorb cash.
red_team.invalidation_test: CFO and cash proxy converge toward profit while receivable days and capitalization ratio decline.

red_team.mechanism: Share price below HK$5.87 leaves the 2026 bond economically out of the money and shifts risk toward repayment/refinancing.
red_team.invalidation_test: Updated cash and committed facilities cover redemption without dilutive or expensive refinancing.

red_team.mechanism: Customer/platform decisions can alter value-added monetization independent of asset count.
red_team.invalidation_test: Customer concentration declines and policy changes do not compress recognized revenue per active asset.

gates.reason: Security, audited filings, current share count, price snapshot and official source hierarchy are resolved; human page review remains required.
gates.next_test: 人工复核 18 条关键页码、单位、范围和公式。

gates.reason: Rights-management mechanics are mapped, but platform algorithms, contracts and legal outcomes are not fully observable.
gates.blocking_gap: 平台合同、算法与争议规则不公开。
gates.next_test: 补客户/权利人访谈与平台条款变化记录。

gates.reason: Revenue and operating KPI growth are strong; receivables, capitalized development and negative all-in cash proxy weaken economic quality.
gates.blocking_gap: 收入增长尚未稳定转成现金。
gates.next_test: 核对 2026H1 应收、CFO、资本化研发和有机增长。

gates.reason: Data/workflow and customer integration support a moat hypothesis, while platform-native substitutes and policy power remain unrefuted.
gates.blocking_gap: 平台内部替代与跨平台数据优势均未被证实。
gates.next_test: 跟踪平台发布前后 NRR、收入/资产和毛利。

gates.reason: Management supplies operating KPIs, but acquisition, capitalization, issuance and bond outcomes need full per-share return evidence.
gates.blocking_gap: 并购、发行与债务的每股回报缺口。
gates.next_test: 建立承诺兑现和 fully diluted per-share return 台账。

gates.reason: Only a conservative cash proxy is reproducible; maintenance development and normalized working capital cannot be separated.
gates.blocking_gap: 维护/增长开发与正常营运资本不可分。
gates.next_test: 用 H1 附注重建维护投入区间和现金桥。

gates.reason: Large September 2026 redemption/refinancing need is material; June cash and committed funding are not disclosed in the monthly return.
gates.blocking_gap: 6 月现金、融资承诺和债券资金桥缺失。
gates.next_test: 到期前核验现金、已承诺额度、赎回/转换及新融资。

gates.reason: Static reported FY PE is reproducible, but TTM, normalized earnings and DCF are unavailable.
gates.blocking_gap: TTM、正常化 owner earnings 和历史分位数缺失。
gates.next_test: 先补可审计分母，再做无前视偏差估值。

gates.reason: Package is research-ready for human review but not decision-ready; bond coverage, cash conversion and platform substitution remain decisive gaps.
gates.blocking_gap: 三个核心 Gate 仍为 provisional/range_only/inconclusive。
gates.next_test: 完成债券、现金转化和平台替代三项反方测试后人工复核。

source_gaps: 2026Q1 absolute revenue, gross margin, profit, cash flow and share denominator.
June/July 2026 cash, bank facilities, covenant headroom and exact convertible redemption funding plan.
Auditable CAC, cohort retention, product/geography margins, asset monetization yield and platform mix.
Maintenance versus growth split for capitalized development and acquired intangibles.
Point-in-time historical PE and normalized public peer set without look-ahead bias.
Borrow fee, lendable inventory and daily free-float-adjusted short interest.

invalidation_tests.claim: Operating growth converts to owner economics.
invalidation_tests.fail_if: Two periods show profit growth while CFO after all development investment remains materially negative.

invalidation_tests.claim: Bond is manageable without value-destructive financing.
invalidation_tests.fail_if: No committed funding bridge before maturity, or new capital materially dilutes per-share economics.

invalidation_tests.claim: AI expands the rights-management opportunity more than it empowers substitutes.
invalidation_tests.fail_if: Active assets grow but NRR, revenue per asset or value-added margin declines after platform AI tools roll out.

invalidation_tests.claim: Moat rests on data/workflow rather than acquisitions alone.
invalidation_tests.fail_if: Organic revenue/cash returns lag while goodwill and capitalized development continue compounding.
invalidation_tests.next_evidence: Acquisition contribution and organic growth bridge.

critical_gaps: Owner earnings unavailable due maintenance/growth and working-capital uncertainty.
Platform substitution and customer concentration lack independent customer evidence.
